principal_decision: Retain controlled gait-signal comparator for tested calcium-containing formulation; broad exercise enhancement and durable HMB-specific function unestablished; no nominee replacement established.

limits: Protocol composition distinguished from direct verification of actual product batch/result Methods.
No isolated HMB-specific causal attribution; calcium is not matched.
No free-acid/retail-product equivalence or measured exposure claim.
formulation.protocol_administration: powder mixed with200mL water once daily after any meal,12weeks
formulation.protocol_placebo: same flavor/presentation; no HMB or calcium, with those amounts replaced by carbohydrate

design.cohort_relation: one cohort with companion explicitly secondary analysis; not independent replication
design.masking_limit: supplement masking plausible; exercise/education observable despite general double-blind wording
design.analyzed_schedule: 12weeks intervention,12weeks observation; later ethical second intervention excluded in native protocol flow
design.secondary: strength, physical performance and other domains

positive.scope: factorial supplement main effect, secondary outcome, multiplicity-adjusted status not verified

negative_or_limit: No reported exercise-by-HMB interaction on primary mass outcomes.
Companion shows no HMB-by-RT interaction on either muscle-quality endpoint.
The strength/multiple-function positives in abstract are exercise main effects.
Most improvements disappear after observation, but HMB-specific gait persistence not numerically established.
Actual final imputation, per-arm missingness, adherence and detailed outcome CIs remain inaccessible.
bub1b_scope: No BUB1B/BubR1 endpoint or MVA experiment identified in read abstracts/protocol; cannot assert comprehensive absence in inaccessible result mains.

registry_history.version3_note: AWGS sarcopenia exclusion absent before protocol February recruitment/Marchbaseline. Source prints SMI<0.57; current/protocol/result abstracts5.7. Historical discrepancy retained, not silently resolved.
registry_history.published_protocol_timing: February2019 after reported2018 intervention/observation; registry supports original mass-primary status but not every later detail

sponsor: Kyowa funded/supplied powders; protocol coauthor employed by Kyowa, reported limited funder role.
competitive: Specific controlled adult gait evidence deserves visibility over blanket rejection; more causal support for this endpoint than appraised open-label niacin strength. Does not establish BUBR1 restoration or outweigh recorded primary pediatric-SMA function for apitegromab. All nominees remain MVA-unproven; no cross-trial MVA efficacy ordering.

integration.research_disposition: retain bounded human functional comparator; broad exercise enhancement and nominee replacement not established
